posts.title: Apollo 11: Catching Some Sun
posts.lead: Bright sunlight glints as long dark shadows mark this image of the surface of the Moon. It was taken on July 20, 1969, by Apollo 11 astronaut Neil Armstrong, the first to walk on the lunar surface.

posts.title: Crew Works Exercise Research and Lab Maintenance on Light Duty Day
posts.lead: The Expedition 75 crew had a light duty day on Friday studying microgravity’s effect on exercise and transferring cargo aboard the International Space Station.

posts.title: NASA Boosts Open Science, Data Sharing with Artemis Accords
posts.lead: The science from every Moon rock sample, lunar dataset, and discovery produced through NASA’s Artemis program will be shared by the agency with the global scientific community.
